strategy.offer: Post-press equipment for folding, bookletmaking, binding, cutting, multifinishing, embellishment, plus used machines, maintenance, training, and spare parts.
strategy.customers: Commercial and digital print providers seeking efficient finishing, distribution preparation, and reliable machine support.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues that automation, productivity, quality, and preventive service reduce downtime, preserve asset value, and help customers differentiate and save time.
strategy.resources: Basis is long experience, specialist technicians, original parts, broad finishing portfolio, live demonstrations, and complementary capabilities across an affiliated group.
strategy.direction: Expand around digital print finishing, integrated automation, and value-adding embellishment while supporting customers from equipment selection through lifecycle service.
